title: Map linga omits the certificate module and its gate
body:
## Summary
The linga context lists 28 paths. The certificate module, imported by five of them, and the rules test npm test already runs, are in no context.

## Description
context-map.json linga file_paths names 28 files and does not name desk/src/lib/english/cert.ts. That file is imported by desk/src/lib/english/rules.ts:2, desk/src/lib/english/conversation.ts:6, desk/src/lib/english/check.ts:14, desk/src/lib/english/view.ts:11 and desk/src/english/LingaPhone.tsx:4. tools/cert-rules-test.cjs is the last command in desk/package.json test:rules and is also absent from every context. tools/linga-cert-live.cjs is a live capture, not in the gate, and stays unmapped. The certificate header (cert.ts:1-22) agrees with the two issue sites: check.ts:127 calls withCertificate without the finishing replies, and conversation.ts:191 passes them; quoteOk (cert.ts:89-93) treats a missing reply as already stored. Fixed means cert.ts and tools/cert-rules-test.cjs are on the linga context. The map is the product's context inventory, so the edit is architecture and was not made this round.

## Flow
- Read the linga file_paths in context-map.json (28 paths, no cert.ts).
- Grep imports of ./cert and @/lib/english/cert: five linga files.
- Confirm desk/package.json test:rules ends with tools/cert-rules-test.cjs, which no context lists.
- Leave the map unchanged.

## Expected impact
The next linga sweep would own the certificate rules and the test that already gates them. Adding paths changes which files a later sweep may edit.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - the map names the files the certificate is
Before: cert.ts and tools/cert-rules-test.cjs are in 0 contexts; cert.ts has 5 importers inside linga
After: those paths listed on linga; not applied
Method: probe - import grep and the npm test script against the map; the map edit is architecture
Result: better
Gate: architecture
evidence: context-map.json linga file_paths (28, no cert.ts); imports at rules.ts:2, conversation.ts:6, check.ts:14, view.ts:11, LingaPhone.tsx:4; desk/package.json test:rules includes tools/cert-rules-test.cjs; tools/linga-cert-live.cjs is not in the gate
